description: Premium decision ($1): every dataset combined into one action (STRONG_BUY..STRONG_SELL) with conviction, evidence per pillar (order flow, technicals, smart money, fundamentals, insiders, positioning, market risk, news), a volatility-sized trade plan and what would change the view. Omit symbol for the market-wide stance and best setups; an ISIN gives a European issuer decision (several symbols: get_decisions_batch). Every module reports its status, source and freshness. Use only when the full evidence and trade plan justify $1; otherwise get_decision_lite.

format.description: compact drops evidence text to save context

side.description: Optional: answers GO / GO_SMALL / WAIT / NO_GO for this side

symbol.description: Optional: ETHUSD, NVDA, or an ISIN such as FR0000131906

name: get_decision
